item.title: ❗️ #Announcement Russia's Victory Museum in Moscow is hosting the “Ordinary Nazism”
item.description: #Announcement ❗️ Russia's Victory Museum in Moscow is hosting the “Ordinary Nazism” exhibition , which traces the origins and evolution of Ukrainian Nazism to the present day. More than 200 exhibits are on display, documenting the atrocities committed by Ukrainian nationalists during #WWII , as well as the mass crimes and terror committed by their modern followers against the people of Ukraine in 2014-2022. LEARN MORE: On the origins of Ukrainian nationalism, the crimes of the OUN-UPA, and the support of the West The exhibits include archival materials from Germany dating from the late 1930s and early 1940s, documents and photographs, alongside case files documenting crimes against humanity committed by Ukrainian nationalists in the Ukrainian SSR. 📄 The “Nazism Today” section features books, uniforms, Ukrainian nationalist propaganda materials and items bearing Nazi symbols, as well as photographs and eyewitness accounts of crimes committed by contemporary neo-Nazis against the people of Ukraine . A central part of the exhibition is an installation dedicated to the children of Donbass who lost their lives . The exhibition features materials from the collections of the Victory Museum, the Donetsk Republican Museum of Local Lore and the Russian State Archive of Social and Political History, as well as the RIA Novosti special project “Donbass. item.title: 🗓 On September 26, at the request of the German side, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov
item.description: 🗓 On September 26, at the request of the German side, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly in New York . They discussed bilateral relations and the situation around Ukraine. On these and other issues, Johann Wadephul reiterated the position of the German government that has been repeatedly stated publicly. #UNGA81

item.description: 💬 Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova : Germany’s Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul requested a meeting with Sergey Lavrov on the sidelines of #UNGA81 . We have held dozens of meetings at the UN. Heads of government and Foreign Ministers from countries that the West dismissively refers to as the “jungle” , supposedly because of their low level of democracy, came to meet Sergey Lavrov. And then a representative of the “beautiful garden” , German FM Johann Wadephul , asked for a meeting with Russia’s Foreign Minister. And what do you think happened? His staff demanded restrictions on media access, guarantees that no questions would be asked, no audio recording of the opening remarks, and an embargo on publishing materials . 👉 That is the “Western democracy of the beautiful garden” ...

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 25, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Republic of Sudan Mohieldin Salem Ahmed Ibrahim
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇸🇩 On September 25, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Republic of Sudan Mohieldin Salem Ahmed Ibrahim held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The discussion focused on the situation in Sudan in the context of the ongoing armed confrontation between the regular army and the rebel Rapid Support Forces. Mohieldin Salem Ahmed Ibrahim thanked Sergey Lavrov for Russia’s principled position in support of Sudan’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity. The Sides praised their close bilateral foreign policy coordination at the UN. They also discussed further strengthening Russia-Sudan relations , with an emphasis on expanding trade, economic and humanitarian cooperation. #RussiaSudan

item.title: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova's statement on the escalation in Northern Ethiopia
item.description: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova's statement on the escalation in Northern Ethiopia (September 25, 2026) We are following with concern developments in Ethiopia’s Tigray, Afar and Amhara regions , where, according to reports, clashes between government forces and illegal Tigrayan armed groups have resumed. ❗️ We call on the parties to the conflict to observe the ceasefire and strictly comply with the existing settlement agreements . We also urge all external actors to refrain from attempts to interfere in Ethiopia’s internal affairs. We firmly believe that preserving Ethiopia’s unity and territorial integrity is the only viable basis for settling all existing differences.

item.title: 🌐 On September 25, Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Pankin took part in the eighth ministerial meeting
item.description: 🌐 On September 25, Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Pankin took part in the eighth ministerial meeting of the Group of Friends in Defence of the UN Charter , held on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . In his remarks, Alexander Pankin highlighted the Group’s vital role in upholding the principles of the UN’s founding document , advancing the legitimate aspirations of the Global South and East, and helping build a truly #MultipolarWorld order. He noted the Group’s effective efforts in key areas such as combating colonialism and its modern manifestations, opposing unilateral coercive measures and preventing the politicisation of human rights . In this context, he stressed the importance of the Group putting forward a new anti-colonial resolution to further consolidate this issue’s place on the UN agenda. 🤝 The Group’s members emphasised the importance of strengthening coordination , broadening the thematic and geographical scope of its activities, and improving its working methods. They also discussed priority and promising areas of the Group’s work for the coming year.
